modules.name: Catalog Hello Test
modules.description: Tests downloading and installing a module. Writes one installed.txt marker inside its own package directory. No vehicle settings or services are changed.
modules.compatibility: Experimental package-manager test. Requires NEMESIS. Physical-car installation has not been verified.

modules.name: Camera Inventory (preview disabled)
modules.description: Diagnostic-only camera inventory and USB reports. All vehicle preview attempts are disabled. This does not enable camera recording or 360 video.
modules.compatibility: Experimental. Declared firmware target only; not a confirmation of head-unit compatibility. Earlier preview releases have a known driver issue.
